questions.question:
Select the most appropriate option to correct the sentence by using meaning of the underlined word.

In the winter season, the poor woman needed a __refuge__ where she could live freely and independently.
questions.solution:
The correct answer is: **Shelter**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"refuge"** means a condition of being safe or sheltered from pursuit, danger, or trouble. (शरण)

 
 
• **Example: **The refugees found **refuge **in a neighboring country.
 
 
 
• **"Shelter" **refers to a place giving temporary protection from bad weather or danger. (आश्रय)
 
 
• **Example: **During the storm, the hikers found **shelter** in a small cabin.
 
 
 
• Hence, we can infer that the correct word for "refuge" in the context of the sentence is "shelter".

Therefore, the correct answer is: **Shelter**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

• **School **(विद्यालय): An institution for educating children.

 
 
• **Example:** She goes to the local school every morning.

• **Example: **We stayed at a cozy inn during our trip to the mountains.
 
 
 
• **Tent** (तम्बू): A portable shelter made of fabric, supported by poles and ropes.
 
 
• **Example:** They set up a tent in the forest for camping.

questions.question:

He lived on the bank of a mighty river, broad and deep, __that have always silently rolling__ on to a vast undiscovered ocean.

__
 
• The word **"which"** is used to introduce a clause giving further information about something mentioned. (जो)

 
 
• **Example: **The book, which I bought yesterday, is already proving to be interesting.
 
 
 
• **"was"** is the past tense of "is," and is used with singular nouns. (था/थी/थे)
 
 
• **Example: **She was happy with her exam results.
 
 
 
• In the given sentence, since **"river"** is a** singular noun**, the correct verb form** "was" should be used.**

Therefore, the correct statement is **"He lived on the bank of a mighty river, broad and deep, which was always silently rolling __on to a vast undiscovered ocean."**

questions.question:
**Select the most appropriate option to substitute the underlined segment in the given sentence.**

Teja is a successful businessman; he always __makes hay when the moon shines__.

options.text: makes hay while the sun sets
makes hay while the sun shines
makes hey while the moon rises
makes hay while the stars twinkle

questions.solution:
The correct answer is: "**makes hay while the sun shines**"**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The original phrase "**he always makes hay when the moon shines**" is a play on the traditional idiom "**make hay while the sun shines**."
 
• The original idiom means to take advantage of favourable conditions or opportunities. (अनुकूल परिस्थितियों या अवसरों का लाभ उठाना)
